text.p: Italian bonds and futures ended easier but off session lows after a rangy day, following other markets but with nothing concrete providing direction.
The Italian market is seen consolidating after recent days' strong gains, traders said.
"It's been very much a rangy day," said one London trader. "We opened slightly lower with other markets and then came off with bunds. The weaker dollar hasn't helped the lira.
"There was some vague talk Italy's 1997 budget might not get through parliament but nothing is really pushing the market. It is consolidating but I'm still bullish," she said.
